title: Ensuring Manpower and Service Level Adequacy with Reopening of Terminals at Changi Airport
what_it_is: Ensuring Manpower and Service Level Adequacy with Reopening of Terminals at Changi Airport

sections.label: Changi Airport passenger traffic recovery
sections.summary: Average weekly passenger traffic at Changi Airport has recovered to above 60% of pre-COVID-19 levels and held steadily.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: As of the first week of September, average weekly passenger traffic at Changi Airport has recovered to above 60% of pre-COVID-19 levels and it has held at that level steadily.

sections.label: Changi Airport physical capacity
sections.summary: Changi Airport will have physical capacity for up to 70 million passengers per annum, about 100% of pre-COVID-19 traffic levels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: With this, Changi Airport will have the physical capacity to accommodate up to 70 million passengers per annum, which is about 100% of the passenger traffic levels that we had pre-COVID-19.

sections.label: Aviation hiring target
sections.summary: Aviation stakeholders aim to hire another 4,000 workers between September and the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Aviation stakeholders aim to hire another 4,000 workers between September and the end of this year.

sections.label: T5 design and process restarted
sections.summary: The Prime Minister announced at the National Day Rally that the design and process for T5 have restarted.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: As was recently announced by the Prime Minister at the National Day Rally, we have restarted the design and process for T5.

sections.label: Sustainable air hub blueprint
sections.summary: CAAS is developing a blueprint for a sustainable air hub in Singapore, with T5 and Changi leading as a sustainable air hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Another aspect has been sustainability and how we can focus on ensuring that T5, but more generally all of Changi, can really lead the way as a sustainable air hub.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: And this is why CAAS is now working on developing a blueprint for a sustainable air hub in Singapore.

sections.label: ICAO Assembly aviation discussion
sections.summary: At the ICAO Assembly, several aviation ministers discussed this as one of the topics.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In fact, I was in the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Assembly earlier last week and this was one of the topics that was discussed by several of the aviation ministers.

sections.label: China share of tourism arrivals
sections.summary: Before COVID-19, China accounted for about 20% of Singapore's tourism visitor arrivals.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: Pre-COVID-19, China would have accounted for about 20% of our tourism visitor arrivals.

sections.label: Aviation manpower shortage and recruitment
sections.summary: Aviation faces a manpower shortage, with one-third workforce attrition, about 4,000 recruited in the first half of this year and a target of another 4,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: We know that there is just a general shortage of manpower and, in particular, for aviation especially on the air side, it is not just about recruitment but we have to make sure that they are trained and they are able to deliver safely for themselves and for all other users of the aviation services.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: But as I said, if I can just take Members back, we had about one-third attrition in our aviation industry workforce.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In the first half of this year, I think about 4,000 were recruited and the aim is really to get another 4,000 workers to join the aviation workforce.
